sentences.en: I have to give a testimony in the courtroom tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我明天要在法庭上作证。

sentences.en: When the judge speaks, everyone in the courtroom listens.
sentences.zh: 当法官说话时，法庭里的所有人都在听。

sentences.en: The defendant is not guilty, but somebody in this courtroom is.
sentences.zh: 被告无罪，但这个房间里有人有罪。
